No other organ pair has both directional deltas positive with mutual-best columns (competitors=none). After relabeling Cloaca<->Stomach, 13/15 organs' own marker sets peak in their own column (before: 11/15); among organs not involved in the swap with informative marker sets (>=3 loci), 11/12 are self-consistent. Remaining deviations (Limb markers partially match Gill due to skeletal-muscle/cartilage genes shared with branchial tissue; Bladder set has <3 informative loci) do not form any competing mutual-best pair. Library sizes differ (min 398,317,869, max 1,398,702,406); scores use CPM-normalized values, so the call is not driven by total library size. Decision is based on marker coherence, unique top pair, and reciprocal (mutual-best) evidence.
